name: security_review
description: Scan code for 19 security patterns: injection (eval/exec/SQL), XSS, hardcoded secrets (JWT/password/API key), CORS *, timing attacks, insecure compare. Severity-graded + score. Deterministic regex, zero LLM.

workspace_dir.description: REQUIRED: project root (abs). reindex first if new.

file.description: File path relative to workspace_dir to scan (reads from disk)

source.description: Source code text to scan (mutually exclusive with file)

scope.description: Directory relative to workspace_dir to scan recursively (default: none, single file only)

max_findings.description: Max findings per file to return (default: 50)
